Juliane

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Re: Fit Statistic Graded Response Model
parts:
Generally in polytomous item style, d is the thresholds for each response options. -a/d is difficulty (b) in IRT. So, It can conversion thresholds (d0 to d5) to difficulty (b0 to b5). Generally and Simply speaking, who can solve very hard test items (or select 6 points on Likert scale which items very hard to do), a person's ability index (as known as 'theta') is test item's difficulty someone can be solve to maximum. Polytomous items' difficulty index concepts are quite hard to understand who met IRT first time.

Seongho

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Fit Statistic Graded Response Model
parts:
When in doubt, use plots. itemplot(mod, 1), or plot(mod, type = 'trace'). That tells you generally how difficult the items are, but then, so does simply finding the average of each item with apply(dat, 2, mean). 

Phil
